title: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels

entities.name: Elspeth Tyrel
entities.description: A planeswalker sent by Ajani who protects Giada, finds her sense of home and purpose in New Capenna, and receives a Halo-forged sword before wounding the Adversary.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker archer who fights beside Elspeth and plans to use Urabrask's revolt against New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A young woman who can make Halo, who discovers her angel family in the cathedral and transforms into the magic of Halo to save Elspeth.

entities.name: Jinnie Fay
entities.description: Jetmir's adoptive daughter and Cabaretti right hand, who captures Elspeth and Vivien and tracks Giada with a spell.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: The wounded boss of the Cabaretti, resting in an Obscura hideout.

entities.name: Kamiz
entities.description: A cephalid Obscura agent who leads the Cabaretti into a trap.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A horned demon planeswalker who has taken over the families, hunts the Font and is wounded by Elspeth before planeswalking away.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: The Maestro who inherits Xander's family and gives Elspeth access to Xander's archives.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: The late head of the Maestros, who left a letter naming Anhelo his successor and ordering that Elspeth be given his archives.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Elspeth's friend and a Gatewatch planeswalker who sent her to New Capenna.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who has told Vivien of a revolution on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of the dead whose cold touch Elspeth recalls as she nearly dies.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: A figure from Elspeth's past linked to her memory of family.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker Elspeth thinks of in the context of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A figure Elspeth thinks of in the context of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A figure Elspeth thinks of in the context of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Angels of New Capenna
entities.description: The ancient angels of Capenna who were betrayed by the Demon Lords and turned into Halo; their statues sing in the cathedral and Giada is one of them.

entities.name: Demon Lords
entities.description: The demons who allied with the angels against the Phyrexians, then betrayed them and converted them into Halo.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: An invading force that once attacked Capenna and is now a threat to everyone.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian regime where Urabrask's revolution might open a window.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers Elspeth will bring the information to.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: The family led by Jetmir that has held Giada.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: A family some of whose members, such as Kamiz, have been compromised by the Adversary.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A family whose brawlers, serving the Adversary, attack the hideout.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: The vampire family now much smaller after the attack and led by Anhelo.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The city plane, in the throes of inter-family war.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane to which Elspeth and Vivien decide to travel.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: The essence of the angels' bodies, a dwindling magic substance that healed Elspeth and held back the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Halo sword
entities.description: A narrower sword with a pommel orb of Halo, transformed from a broadsword by Giada's gift.

entities.name: Xander's Archives
entities.description: A hidden archive in the Maestros' museum holding Capenna's histories and a cache of Halo.

entities.name: Maestros' Museum
entities.description: The museum of the Maestros in Park Heights, which is being repaired.

entities.name: Cloud Spire
entities.description: The main Obscura stronghold in Park Heights.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The top level of New Capenna, where the cathedral stands.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The middle level, through which the captives are escorted.

entities.name: Cathedral of the angels
entities.description: A cathedral in Park Heights with glowing, singing angel statues, where Giada finds her family.

entities.name: The Vantoleone
entities.description: The compromised theater where the Crescendo was held.

entities.name: Grand Cenobite
entities.description: Elspeth's former prison and the Phyrexian capital.

entities.name: The Crescendo
entities.description: The party at which the Adversary's infiltrators struck every family.

events.summary: Elspeth, Vivien and Giada shelter in an abandoned warehouse, where Giada confesses her fear that her magic is not enough and Elspeth vows to keep her safe.
events.quote: "And I will personally ensure you are safe to take the time you need to do so, however long that is."

events.summary: Jinnie and Cabaretti enforcers storm the warehouse office, disarming Vivien and holding a knife to Elspeth's throat.
events.quote: "You didn't really think you could escape us, did you?"

events.summary: Giada defends Elspeth, persuading Jinnie to let Jetmir decide; Jinnie shackles the two and takes them with Giada to see Jetmir.
events.quote: "Shackle them. We're taking them back to Jetmir."

events.summary: Jinnie leads them to an Obscura hideout where Kamiz welcomes them, and a wounded Jetmir is being treated.
events.quote: "I see you were successful." Jetmir was settled in a lower bunk

events.summary: Giada makes Halo to heal Jetmir, but Riveteers and Maestro assassins burst in, and Elspeth and Vivien break free of their shackles.
events.quote: With a thought, her magic cracked open the locks

events.summary: Elspeth is mortally wounded in the brawl, seeing Erebos's cold approach, until Giada feeds her Halo that heals her.
events.quote: It smashed into her ribs as Elspeth had been straining to hoist her sword

events.summary: Giada's Halo mends Elspeth's bones; Elspeth sees Giada's glow.
Kamiz leads the group through Obscura tunnels toward the Cloud Spire; Giada drops a tracking bracelet and Elspeth destroys it.
events.quote: Elspeth ground the bracelet under her boot.

events.summary: Obscura enforcers ambush them in the park; Kamiz's trap is revealed and Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee as Jinnie fights.
events.quote: This had all been a setup.

events.summary: In the cathedral Elspeth and Giada hear the angels' statues sing; Giada says it is her family and that she is home, and Elspeth realizes home is purpose.
Ob Nixilis arrives at the cathedral with enforcers; Vivien fires on him and Elspeth fights him but is thrown back.
events.quote: "Good of you to show yourself, Ob Nixilis."

events.summary: Giada transforms into the radiant magic of Halo, blasting Ob Nixilis away and giving Elspeth strength.
events.quote: Giada was transformed into the radiant magic of Halo.

events.summary: Elspeth's broadsword is transformed into a Halo-pommeled blade and she vows to defend New Capenna.
events.quote: The pommel wasn't a practical steel guard but an orb of Halo

events.summary: Elspeth wounds Ob Nixilis's neck with the new sword, and he planeswalks away.
events.quote: In a blink, he was gone, having planeswalked away.

events.summary: Anhelo gives Elspeth and Vivien Xander's letter naming him successor and granting Elspeth access to the archives.
events.quote: The Maestros are now in your hands

events.summary: Elspeth and Vivien read the archives and learn the Phyrexians once attacked Capenna and the Demon Lords betrayed the angels to make Halo.
events.quote: The demons ultimately betrayed the angels

events.summary: Vivien tells Elspeth of Urabrask's planned revolution on New Phyrexia, and they decide to take the Halo and the news to Dominaria.
events.quote: "Dominaria." Elspeth turned away from the city skyline of New Capenna.

relations.note: Believes Elspeth is a traitor who took the Font.
relations.quote: "Liar. You wanted the Font for yourself."

relations.note: An Obscura agent in a navy trench coat.
relations.quote: Her clothing and cloche hat were of a similar make to the Obscura

relations.note: Leads Jinnie into a trap, serving the Adversary's side.
relations.quote: Jinnie had no doubt turned her rage on Kamiz immediately upon realizing her deception.

relations.note: Fight together and plan to go to Dominaria.
relations.quote: Elspeth was pleased it seemed like Vivien was ready to continue this journey with her.
Steel met flesh, and she grazed off the side of his neck.

relations.note: He left the Maestros in Anhelo's hands.
relations.quote: The Maestros are now in your hands
Make our family your own as you see fit.

relations.note: Betrayed the angels and turned them into Halo.
relations.quote: The demons ultimately betrayed the angels

relations.note: Giada recognizes the angels as her family.

relations.quote: she had resented her dear friend in those long-ago moments
